info.title: Emithran Manufacturing Intelligence API
info.description: REST API over the Emithran manufacturing taxonomy, materials, machines, processes, prices and market data.

post.description: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials grant (RFC 6749 §4.4). Send `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` with `grant_type=client_credentials`, `client_id`, `client_secret` (or HTTP Basic) and an optional space-separated `scope`. Returns a bearer token valid for the client's TTL (default 3600 s).

post.description:
Searches objects of the given type with a filter tree, ordering, property selection and paging.

| Query type | Description |
|---|---|
| `eq`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte` | Compare a scalar property with `value`. |
| `isNull` | `value: true` matches nulls, `false` non-nulls. |
| `in` | Property equals one of the listed values. |
| `contains` | Array property contains `value` (e.g. `qualityFlags`). |
| `startsWith` | Case-insensitive string prefix. |
| `containsAnyTerm` / `containsAllTerms` | Case-insensitive term match on a string. |
| `and`, `or` | `value` is a list of clauses. |
| `not` | `value` is one clause. |

**Preview** — call with `preview=true`. Ranks alternative materials for a process. Candidates must be listed for the same category, share the material class (and by default the family) and carry the reference's process capability flags (e.g. `Can Die Cast`). Nothing is estimated: factors without data are reported as null.
